title: A Day in Paris
subtitle: 考点：一般过去时 / Did you see ...?

dialogue.t: Tom, where did you go in the summer holiday?
I went to Paris with my aunt.
Did you see the Eiffel Tower?
Yes! We went up it. The view was inspiring.
We ate dinner in a small restaurant. I ate bread and soup.
Yes, I took a photo of the tower at night.

vocab: Paris 巴黎 · Eiffel Tower 埃菲尔铁塔 · view 景色 · inspiring 令人振奋的 · restaurant 餐馆 · aunt 姑姑/阿姨
